results.content: The Trump administration’s tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts have cost automakers a staggering $35.4 billion since their implementation in 2025, according to an analysis of financial reports by Automotive News. Toyota has been the hardest hit, projecting $9.1 billion in tariff-related costs for the fiscal year ending March 2026. The three major Detroit automakers—General Motors, Ford, and Stellantis—collectively incurred $6.5 billion in costs in 2025, while other global brands like [...] The White House announced that passenger vehicles, certain trucks, and auto parts will be exempt from the new 10% global tariff set to take effect on February 24, 2026. This decision provides relief to automakers and dealers who were concerned about additional cost pressures, especially as the industry already faces significant expenses from existing tariffs on steel, aluminum, and imported auto parts. These sector-specific tariffs, implemented under national security grounds, remain unaffected [...] consumers faced affordability challenges, particularly for entry-level vehicles. Automakers adjusted pricing strategies by incorporating costs into destination fees, which reached record highs for 2026 models, such as $2,795 for full-size GM and Ford trucks and SUVs.
